Burglary at jailed ex-judge's home in Twisha Sharma case

The home of Giribala Singh, a former judge and an accused in the Twisha Sharma death case, was burgled. Three masked individuals reportedly broke into her house, stealing valuables and documents. Police are investigating the incident, with some reports suggesting a potential attempt to tamper with evidence.
